purpose: Prove the generated authoritative Uniracers guest/title C can compile for Switch AArch64 independently of the desktop runner.
acceptance: the canonical USA ROM is verified before generation
the repository-owned patched SNESRecomp framework is staged offline
AOT C is generated from the canonical ROM and scaffold CFG
game_rtl.c, host_contract.c, gen_stubs.c and every generated src/gen/*.c file compile with devkitA64 and __SWITCH__ defined
the probe compiles no desktop host translation unit
non_claims: This does not link the SNES hardware/runtime model yet
This does not run the guest on Switch hardware
This does not prove event-relative deterministic parity on Switch
This does not close Gate S2
This does not modify generated simulation semantics
